div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ATOMIC CRITERIA
Binary: passes or fails stated objective
Clean Pass / Fail boundary
Ensures evaluable single claim

div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PASS
Green light: 9/9 must pass

div.style: color: rgb(127, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FAIL
Agent does not issue green light
Remediation plan required in Section 4

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STACKED (SCORED) CRITERIA
Scaled mode 0.0 to 1.0 per cell
3x3 nine-cell grid
Rows: Pathos / Ethos / Logos
Cols: Coverage / Self-contained / Importance

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BUNDLED CRITERIA
Multiple sub-criteria stacked
Single handle treated as unit
Example: headings bundle

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 1: CLAIM AND CONTEXTUALIZE
Claim one task at a time
Rubric Suggestions tool for guidance only
System Prompt overrides all

div.style: color: rgb(60, 0, 107) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THE PROMPT HIERARCHY
System Prompt (highest authority)
User Turns (specific corrections)
Rubric Suggestions (guidance only)

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEPS 5 to 6: REVIEW AND ADJUST
Evaluate pre-populated criteria
Check against Common Errors list
Adjust rubric entries accordingly

div.style: color: rgb(60, 0, 107) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STEP 7: QUALITY CHECK AND SUBMIT
Run Diagnostic tool
Confirm source hierarchy compliance
Submit for Architect verdict

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THREE-PART ENTRY FORMAT
1. WRITING THE JUSTIFICATION
Explain why criterion necessary or not
Cite specific prompt or system prompt instruction
2. CORRECTED CRITERION
One-sentence canonical form
3. ONE-SENTENCE SUMMARY
Compressed action description

div.style: color: rgb(127, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ACTION: DELETE / ELSE
Criterion subsumed by System Prompt
Violates scope constraint
Example justification: out of scope

div.style: color: rgb(109, 45, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ACTION: MODIFY / ADD
Criterion needs reformulation
Include section to cover missed requirements
Rephrase to objective standard

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CRITERIA MUST BE BINARY
Replace subjective words like thorough
with objective facts or specific data
No vague scope language permitted

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CONTENT: DEEP PROCESS
Trade the brief for the model's
internal evaluation or methodology
Not surface-level summary

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
REFERENCE TO CONTEXT
Explicitly mention previous turns
Ground criterion in session context
Include Type I and Type II error framing

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SELF-CONTAINMENT VS. MEMORY
Criteria self-contained within
Model's Memory First window
Referenced in prompt itself

div.style: color: rgb(74, 0, 114) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Subjective
Vague criteria
Fix: measurable objective statements

div.style: color: rgb(74, 0, 114) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Open-Ended
Unconstrained evaluation
Fix: include all constraints explicitly

div.style: color: rgb(74, 0, 114) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Over-Specific
Evaluates only review-time info
Fix: evaluate only stated content

div.style: color: rgb(74, 0, 114) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Process-Oriented
Focuses on process not outcome
Fix: rephrase to outcome existence

div.style: color: rgb(60, 0, 107) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ARCHITECT VERDICT
Pathos / Ethos / Logos
PEL Approval Gate
Sage-only issuance
Agent never self-issues verdict

div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
APPROVED
Proceed to Step 7.3 publish path

div.style: color: rgb(109, 45, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
REVISIONS
Architect lists revisions
Agent loops to Phase 6

div.style: color: rgb(127, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
REJECTED
Handoff packet v2
Agent packages state and stops
